question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` require canonical base-10 text, or continue accepting equivalent safe-integer spellings such as `+500` and `0500`?
rationale: The values have identical runtime meaning, current docs do not specify canonical spelling, and rejecting them intentionally changes an accepted public CLI input contract.

options.title: Preserve accepted spellings
options.body: Keep the current numeric contract because the aliases produce the same cadence and no observable bug has been demonstrated.

options.title: Adopt canonical spelling
options.body: Approve the compatibility break, document canonical decimal syntax, and require real CLI upgrade/control proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve accepted spellings
recommendation.body: Keep the current numeric contract because the aliases produce the same cadence and no observable bug has been demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent strict CLI validation work makes this the strongest available owner for the public input-contract decision.
